tree.heading: General rule
tree.text: Except as otherwise provided in this section, neither the Secretary nor any other officer or employee of the Treasury Department may divulge or make known in any manner whatever to any person—

children.text: any original, copy, or abstract of any return, payment, or registration made pursuant to this chapter,
any record required for making any such return, payment, or registration, which the Secretary is permitted by the taxpayer to examine or which is produced pursuant to section 7602, or
any information come at by the exploitation of any such return, payment, registration, or record.

tree.heading: Permissible disclosure
tree.text: A disclosure otherwise prohibited by subsection (a) may be made in connection with the administration or civil or criminal enforcement of any tax imposed by this title. However, any document or information so disclosed may not be—

children.text: divulged or made known in any manner whatever by any officer or employee of the United States to any person except in connection with the administration or civil or criminal enforcement of this title, nor
used, directly or indirectly, in any criminal prosecution for any offense occurring before the date of enactment of this section.

tree.heading: Use of documents possessed by taxpayer
tree.text: Except in connection with the administration or civil or criminal enforcement of any tax imposed by this title— shall not be used against such taxpayer in any criminal proceeding.

children.text: any stamp denoting payment of the special tax under this chapter,
any original, copy, or abstract possessed by a taxpayer of any return, payment, or registration made by such taxpayer pursuant to this chapter, and
any information come at by the exploitation of any such document,

tree.heading: Inspection by committees of Congress
tree.text: Section 6103(f) shall apply with respect to any return, payment, or registration made pursuant to this chapter.
